transition.name: OuzFX AFX_Cam_Whip_Push_Out_Left
transition.description: Whip-pan push transition: the outgoing clip (lower track) whips out to the left while the incoming clip (upper track) pushes in behind it – expo ease-in-out, so it is slow at the edges and a blur-fast smear in the middle. Overlap the two clips by 6–12 frames and drop it on the overlap. Built on Kdenlive's Push composition (frei0r sleid0r).
transition.author: Oğuz Kaan Özsoy (OuzFX)
